title: fix(auth)!: the environment-access gate on /oauth2/authorize judges every client the request names
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` and no hand-written page under `content/docs/**` teaches `oidcAuthorizeGate` or the authorize endpoint's environment-access gate.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`/oauth2/authorize` 上的环境访问门(`oidcAuthorizeGate`)现在对请求点名的每一个客户端逐一裁决(查询串与请求体里的 `client_id`,字符串或数组,去重),任一被拒即以现有的 403 `ENV_ACCESS_DENIED` 拒绝。
- 为什么改:门的裁决范围应覆盖请求点名的全部客户端,规则以此为准。
- 风险与回滚:只影响设置了 `oidcAuthorizeGate` 的部署(托管控制面);开源版与自托管不设,行为不变。回滚即 revert 本提交。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-before-hook.ts`(`authorizeRequestClientIds` 与门的循环)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts`(新增两个 describe)、`.changeset/authorize-gate-judges-every-client-id.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts`,预期 31 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The ADR-0069 D5.1 environment-access gate on `/oauth2/authorize` judges every client the request names: the query's `client_id` and the body's `client_id`, each a string or an array, de-duplicated (query first). It refuses with its existing refusal if any one is refused: `403 ENV_ACCESS_DENIED` for a fetch or API client, and for a browser the redirect or readable page it already gets (`oauth-authorize-refusal.ts`, unchanged). A request that names no client anywhere is unchanged, and so is an unauthenticated request.

BREAKING only for a host whose `oidcAuthorizeGate` assumes one call per request: it can now be called once per distinct client named. The callback signature does not change.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts` (real `AuthManager` + `@better-auth/oauth-provider`), two new top-level describes in the existing harness:

- the gate judges every client the request names: GET refused; form POST refused (envelope); form POST from a browser navigation answers the page, as a refused POST is answered today; JSON POST answers the provider's 415; a query/body pair refused in either order; a form body naming two clients is issued a code only for a client the gate judged and admitted, in either order; a query naming the client twice is refused when either is refused, each judged by itself, in either order; a client named in both judged once; CONTROL an admitted form POST is handed a code; CONTROL a request naming no client is not judged.
- the gate judges every pass that resumes an authorization: sign-in resume, `POST /oauth2/consent`, `POST /oauth2/continue`, each with a denying-gate leg (refused) and an admitting control (code). A resume pass naming a client that is not a string is judged on that value and refused when it is refused.

`packages/qa/dogfood/test/oidc-authorize-env-gate.dogfood.test.ts`: form POST naming the client in the body refused; query/body pair refused; CONTROL admitting gate hands a code.
